title: Find the Kidnappers
description: Bandits north of Dalhurst have a merchant's daughter and have named a price he could pay twice over without missing a meal. He is not paying it. Every merchant who pays once pays again within the year, he says, and he will not spend the rest of his life buying her back a season at a time. So he is paying a stranger instead, and living with what that means.

objectives.description: Find the bandit camp north of Dalhurst before they lose patience with the merchant's silence

notes: Threat: a merchant's daughter held for ransom he can afford but has decided not to pay. Giver motive: refusing on principle - paying once marks you as a payer for good - and hiring a stranger's sword instead of his own gold. Consequence of refusal to act: unwired - the bandits keep her as long as they think a price is coming.
